shipTerminal.name: Grand Turk Cruise Center
shipTerminal.description: The cruise ship terminal at the south-west of the island, with shops, the beach and the pier. Return to Ship routes you here - allow plenty of time before all-aboard.
shipTerminal.accessNotes: Return-to-ship endpoint is PROVISIONAL until the approved terminal approach point is confirmed (OD-02).

destinations.name: Governor's Beach
destinations.description: A wide white-sand beach with clear turquoise water and shade trees, popular for swimming and relaxing. One of the closest beaches to the Cruise Center.
destinations.facts: The beach takes its name from Waterloo, the Governor’s residence close by.

destinations.name: Guanahani Beach (Pillory Beach)
destinations.description: A calm white-sand beach north of Cockburn Town, officially renamed Guanahani Beach in 1992. Good snorkelling close to shore.
destinations.accessNotes: Access: the small parking area at the north end of Front Street (source: visittci.com).
destinations.facts: Guanahani was the Taíno name for the island where Columbus first landed in 1492.

destinations.name: Osprey Beach
destinations.description: A small beach along the Cockburn Town waterfront, beside historic Front Street.

destinations.name: Boaby Rock Beach
destinations.description: A quieter beach on the south-east of the island with rocky outcrops and open views.

destinations.name: White Sands Beach
destinations.description: A secluded stretch of sand at the southern end of Grand Turk.

destinations.name: Cockburn Town
destinations.description: The capital of the Turks and Caicos Islands, with colonial-era buildings, churches and the waterfront along Front Street and Duke Street.
destinations.facts: Cockburn Town is the capital of the Turks and Caicos Islands.

destinations.name: Lighthouse
destinations.description: The historic cast-iron lighthouse at the island's northern tip, overlooking the reef and the Atlantic.
destinations.facts: The lighthouse was built in 1852 from cast-iron sections made in England, to warn ships away from the reefs off the northern tip.

destinations.name: Front Street
destinations.description: The historic waterfront street of Cockburn Town, lined with old Bermudian-style buildings.
destinations.facts: Many buildings on Front Street date from the Bermudian salt-raking era.

destinations.name: Turks and Caicos National Museum
destinations.description: The national museum on Front Street, covering the islands' natural and cultural history.
destinations.facts: The museum displays the Molasses Reef wreck, one of the oldest European shipwrecks found in the Americas.

destinations.name: H.M. Prison Museum
destinations.description: The 19th-century Her Majesty’s Prison, now a museum where visitors can see the old cells and courtyard.

destinations.name: St. Mary’s Anglican Pro-Cathedral
destinations.description: St. Mary’s Anglican Pro-Cathedral, a historic church on the Cockburn Town waterfront.

destinations.name: St. Thomas Anglican Church
destinations.description: One of the oldest church sites on Grand Turk, north of the town centre.

destinations.name: Columbus Landfall National Park
destinations.description: A protected marine park along the west coast, commemorating one of the proposed landfall sites of Columbus in 1492.
destinations.facts: Grand Turk is one of the islands proposed as Christopher Columbus’s first landfall in 1492.

destinations.name: Waterloo (Governor's Residence)
destinations.description: The official residence of the Governor. View from outside only - not open to visitors.
destinations.facts: Waterloo has served as the official residence of the Governor of the Turks and Caicos Islands.

destinations.name: Odd Fellows Lodge
destinations.description: A historic lodge building in Cockburn Town.

destinations.name: Victoria Public Library
destinations.description: A historic public library building in Cockburn Town.

destinations.name: Town Salina
destinations.description: A historic salt pond behind Cockburn Town, a reminder of the island's salt-raking past and a place to spot wading birds.
destinations.facts: Salt was raked from Grand Turk’s salinas for centuries, and was once the island’s main export.

destinations.name: Red Salina
destinations.description: A large salt pond in the south of the island, home to shorebirds and occasionally flamingos.
destinations.facts: Salt was raked from Grand Turk’s salinas for centuries, and was once the island’s main export.

destinations.name: Hawks Nest Salina
destinations.description: A salt pond and wetland on the south-east of the island, good for birdwatching.

destinations.name: North Creek
destinations.description: A sheltered inland lagoon in the north of the island, lined with mangroves.

destinations.name: Gibbs Cay
destinations.description: A small uninhabited cay east of Grand Turk, reached only by boat tour. Shown for information - it cannot be reached on foot.
destinations.facts: Gibbs Cay is known for boat tours where visitors can see southern stingrays in shallow water.

destinations.name: JAGS McCartney Airport
destinations.description: Grand Turk's airport, between Cockburn Town and the Cruise Center.

destinations.name: Margaritaville Grand Turk
destinations.description: A large beach bar and restaurant with a pool, beside the Cruise Center.

destinations.name: Jack’s Shack Beach Bar & Grill
destinations.description: A casual beach bar on the sand, a short walk north of the Cruise Center.

destinations.name: Sandbar Restaurant
destinations.description: A waterfront bar and grill on Duke Street in Cockburn Town.

destinations.name: Salt Raker Inn
destinations.description: A historic inn with a garden restaurant on the Cockburn Town waterfront.

destinations.name: Bohio Dive Resort
destinations.description: A beachfront resort with restaurant and dive centre on Pillory Beach.

destinations.name: Shoprite Grocery
destinations.description: A grocery store for snacks, water and everyday supplies.

destinations.name: Ron Jon Surf Shop
destinations.description: Beachwear, souvenirs and surf gear beside the Cruise Center.

destinations.name: Harbor House
destinations.description: A gift shop in Cockburn Town.

destinations.name: Island Creations
destinations.description: Local art and handmade island crafts.

destinations.name: Hospital
destinations.description: Grand Turk’s hospital (Cockburn Town Medical Centre), with emergency care. In an emergency, call 911.

destinations.name: Royal Turks and Caicos Police Station
destinations.description: The main police station on Grand Turk. In an emergency, call 911.

destinations.name: General Post Office
destinations.description: Post office in Cockburn Town.

destinations.name: Scotiabank
destinations.description: Bank in Cockburn Town.

destinations.name: CIBC Caribbean (Bank)
destinations.description: CIBC Caribbean (FirstCaribbean) bank branch with ATM in Cockburn Town.

destinations.name: Barbie’s Bar & Restaurant
destinations.description: A local bar and restaurant serving island food.

destinations.name: Freemason Lodge
destinations.description: The historic Grand Turk Masonic Lodge on Front Street at Freemason Alley, built of hand-cut limestone.
destinations.facts: The lodge opened in 1855 and was founded by Frederick Forth, the first president of the Turks and Caicos Islands.
destinations.accessNotes: View from outside - meetings are closed to the public.

destinations.name: John Glenn Splashdown Exhibit
destinations.description: An exhibit at the Cruise Center about NASA’s Mercury programme and John Glenn’s Friendship 7 flight.
destinations.facts: After the first American orbital flight in February 1962, John Glenn’s Friendship 7 capsule splashed down near Grand Turk.

destinations.name: Graceway Supermarket
destinations.description: A full-service supermarket on Church Folly, Cockburn Town.
destinations.accessNotes: Map position not yet verified (address: Church Folly, near the salinas).

destinations.name: Grace Bay Pharmacy
destinations.description: A dispensing pharmacy next to Graceway on Church Folly, Cockburn Town.
destinations.accessNotes: Map position not yet verified (address: Church Folly, near the salinas).

destinations.name: Clock Tower Park
destinations.description: A small park with the Millennium Clock Tower in Cockburn Town.
